title: Candidate Ranking Transfer
goal: Screen a directory of light curves from several survey targets, identify which targets contain convincing transit candidates, and produce /root/candidate_ranking.csv with target_id, best_period_days, and detection_score ordered from strongest to weakest candidate.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfers transit-least-squares from single-target analysis to batch survey triage, where transit-focused period searches and candidate strength metrics are the essential domain capability.
